integrity: Complete algebraic proof and separate finite matrix/direct simulation programs included. Earlier reversible rule and incidence identity explicitly credited. External independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to all finite projective planes of order at least two not divisible by three, reversible neighbor-sum with previous-state subtraction, and update fields of characteristic three. No assertion for plane order divisible by three, other characteristics, graph isomorphism or nonlinear dynamics. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: A characteristic-three clock bifurcation for reversible waves on projective-plane incidence graphs
